test.create(/runner::run)
runner.create(wrapper)
runner.create(wrapper::/middle::box)
runner.create(wrapper::/middle::run)
middle.create(box::/worker::input)
middle.create(box::/worker::run)
worker.move(input, output)
worker.destroy(run)
middle.move(box::/worker::output, final)
middle.destroy(box)
middle.destroy(run)
runner.destroy(wrapper::/middle::final)
runner.destroy(wrapper)
test.destroy(/runner::run)
